newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Scania makes further gains in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Scania makes further gains in late trade.

text.p: Shares in Swedish truck maker Scania accelerated on the Stockholm stock exchange, adding to the small gains immediately after it released its first quarter profits, dealers said.
The share ended 3.5 crowns higher at 192 crowns, after having been volatile after the report was released.
Scania's first quarter profit almost halved to 577 million crowns, lower than the 608 million crowns which was forecast in a Reuter poll of analysts.
Dealers said the shares were spurred by relief that the first quarter profit was not worse.
"Market players already knew the report would be bad, so that was not a large surprise," a trader said. "They just kept buying."
